name: LEBTECH
recent: LEBTECH 近期公布了一项关联方债务清偿方案，拟以 RM62.4 million 收购 Asia Fortune 2000 Sdn Bhd 全部股权，以结清 Lebar Daun Development 与 Basco 的欠款。公司同时接受关联方 LDD 颁发价值 RM46.4 million 的住宅建设项目合约。最新季度业绩（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）已发布，但资料未提供具体财务数字。
notable: 拟以 RM62,425,529 收购 Asia Fortune 2000 Sdn Bhd 全部股权，作为关联方债务清偿方案的一部分。
全资子公司 Lebtech Construction 接受关联方 LDD 颁发的 RM46,361,817 住宅建设项目合约。
risks: 债务清偿方案涉及关联方交易，需独立顾问评估并可能需股东批准。
公司涉及重大诉讼（2026 年 8 月 28 日公告），具体内容未提供。

recent_en: LEBTECH recently announced a related-party debt settlement proposal to acquire the entire equity interest in Asia Fortune 2000 Sdn Bhd for RM62.4 million to settle amounts due from Lebar Daun Development and Basco. The company also accepted a RM46.4 million residential construction contract from related party LDD. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 were released, but no specific financial figures were provided in the materials.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of the entire equity interest in Asia Fortune 2000 Sdn Bhd for RM62,425,529 as part of a related-party debt settlement.
Wholly-owned subsidiary Lebtech Construction accepted a RM46,361,817 residential construction contract from related party LDD.
risks_en: The debt settlement is a related-party transaction requiring independent adviser assessment and potentially shareholder approval.
The company is involved in material litigation (announced 28 August 2026); details were not provided.
